info.name: Genda Phool E-Commerce API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Genda Phool Backend - 126 endpoints across 19 sections.

Includes: Authentication, User Profile, Address, Products, Cart, Orders, POS, Payments (Razorpay + Wallet), Subscriptions, Support, Notifications, Delivery Partner, Delivery Slots, Discounts, Invoices, Admin & Analytics.

Base URL: http://185.137.122.250:8083/api/v1
Swagger Docs: http://185.137.122.250:8083/api/docs/

request.description: List all coupons available to the authenticated customer. Returns global coupons + store-specific coupons (if store_id provided). Automatically filters by validity, usage limits, and user eligibility.
Get user's shopping cart with items and totals.

Add a product to the cart for a specific store.

Inventory rules:
- Perishable products: no stock check (always available for scheduled orders).
- Non-perishable: must have sufficient available_quantity in the store's inventory.

Switch the cart to a different store.

Items available at the new store are kept (price updated). Items not available are removed. Response includes kept_items and removed_items arrays.

Step 1 of Razorpay checkout. Creates Razorpay order from cart. No actual Order is created yet. Returns razorpay_order_id.
Step 2 - verifies payment signature and creates the actual order. Cart is cleared.
Optional polling endpoint. After calling verify/, poll this to confirm the order was created. Returns status (pending/completed/failed), order_number and razorpay_payment_id when completed.
